spec: Implement `place_order`: an order is placed by first checking stock for the item (items with id below 1000 are known), then reserving inventory. The stock service returns the confirmed quantity as Ok(qty) for known items and Err("out of stock") otherwise; the reservation service accepts orders up to its per-order limit and rejects larger ones with Err("qty limit"). A successful order returns the confirmed quantity as the order id. The caller must detect when a service's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: stock_check
externs.contract:
requires item > 0
requires qty > 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (item < 1000)
ensures (not is_ok(result)) or unwrap_ok(result) == qty

externs.name: inventory_reserve
externs.contract:
requires item > 0
requires qty > 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (qty <= 20)

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} stock_check(item: int, qty: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires item > 0
  requires qty > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (item < 1000)
  ensures !result.Ok? || result.value == qty

method {:extern}{:axiom} inventory_reserve(item: int, qty: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires item > 0
  requires qty > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (qty <= 20)
